hard: Feed pump 78141 centre (x~2004) is only just inside the region edge x=2000; its box is clipped to x0=2000 and its suction side (check valve, inlet line) lies outside the region.
B4 circle centre y~1642 is just inside the top edge y=1633; box clipped to y0=1633. The still-vapor-trap top valve (v_trap) is likewise clipped at y=1633.

Circled letter+digit symbols (B2, B4, AB, A2, A4, A5, B6, B7 x2, C2, C3, D5, E11, E12, J4) are 'local mounted instr.' per the sheet legend; keyed as instrumentation per the brief as test points / sample points. Most have no drawn connecting line; only B2, AB and J4 are linked (i).

Boxed tags (BTIC/BHPA/BPI/BLI/BTIM/BTRM/BTRC/SPRC) are board-mounted instruments, keyed as instrumentation. Side-by-side BHPA+BPI pairs share one tap line drawn from the BPI box, so only the BPI box gets the i-edge.

Crossings vs joins: this sheet draws a crossing as a semicircular hop on one of the two lines; a plain T meeting with no hop is treated as a join. The long verticals x~2966 (216-1/2-P), x~3010 (217-1/2-P), x~3262, x~3480 and x~3533 hop over the 319-1-Q (y~2507) and 211-2-P (y~2547) horizontals.

Heavy double / solid+dashed lines are preheated process lines (legend: lines to be preheated to 500F); keyed as ordinary p edges along the solid pipe; the dashed tracer outlines (around 208-4-P/218-1/2-P and sample tube 2) are not edges.

The still bottom outlet at x~2988, y~2172 is drawn through the electric heater coil with heavy scan noise; read as a tee into a right-going branch that tees again at x~3008 (210-2-P right, 217-1/2-P down). These may be one tee in the drawing.

218-1/2-P is read as branching up off 208-4-P at x~2830 (vapour line), running right along y~1706, then down x~3530 to the cold-trap valve; the vertical x~3480 next to it is a separate line from above the region feeding sample tube 3 (no edge beyond the tube).
The vertical from the still cooler (207-3/4-P, x~2787) runs up to y~1706 and left to the condenser head; BTRM 304 and BPI 304 tap it. Treated as a process line condenser<->cooler.
The sample hood (thin outline enclosure) is not keyed as a symbol; its TO BLOWER nozzle is keyed as inlet/outlet with no edges.
The dash-dot control valve at x~2043, y~1743 belongs to 'lines and equipment appearing ref P&I dwgs' (cooling-water system); keyed as a valve but its lines leave the region, so no edges.
Line labels in ovals (208-4-P, 319-1-Q, ...) are not keyed; the short valve-spec ovals next to valves (2-5, 1-4, 1-23, 3/4-23) are recorded as the valve tag text where adjacent.

uncertain.why: small '||' pair after the feed-pump check valve, pointed at by J4; could be a flange pair/union rather than a flow element
empty circle with no text and no line near the steam vent; keyed as instrumentation
electric heater coil around the still bottom keyed as a separate general symbol; no process edge to the still; SPRC 300 dashed line read as its control signal
AB circle linked to the vapour-trap top valve via a short '1-4' line; it may be a separate line passing the valve
possibly the same tee as j_still (noisy heater area)
hood exhaust nozzle; not on any keyed line
cup-shaped end below the 316/319 tee read as an open drain
hook end of 326-1-0 'from EQ 78641' read as an off-sheet connector symbol
sample tube boxes (tube1-3) include the U-tube and its leg caps; couplings under the valves are not keyed separately
the 218-1/2-P branch off 208-4-P is partly hidden under the preheat dashes

not_keyed: figure caption 'Fig. 9 Piping and Instrumentation Diagram', page number 39, OSTI ID stamp and handwritten '095-35'
line-label ovals and flow arrows; text labels such as GRAVITY FLOW, SAMPLING AREA
waste-storage-tank dip-stick nozzle (part of the tank)
sample hood enclosure outline and the long dash-dot area boundary at y~2600
line ends with no symbol (cooling H2O system inlet at x~2593, cooler drain below v_cdrain, vacuum-pump exhaust arrow)

consistency_check.method: same agent re-keyed, from fresh crops and without opening the key, every symbol whose centre lies in a seeded random 20% of a 5 x 4 cell grid (seed 20261029) and the links between those symbols; compared at IoU >= 0.5 with class. NOT independent: the same agent made the key and still had it in context.
consistency_check.note: cells are in full-image pixels; two of the four cells hold no symbols, so the sample is 13 of 85 symbols

omre_q4.scope: ONE QUADRANT ONLY (bottom-right of the sheet); the rest is not keyed, so score only on the crop
